source: sars-guide:SARS PAYE-GEN-01-G21 Guide for Employers iro Employees Tax 2027, Revision 1 p. 9-10 (annual equivalent of part-period pay; a part period as its share of days, 3 of 7 = 0.4285) and p. 13; apportionment basis: wave-7 ruling 13 (monthly working days, weekly calendar days), scope ruling 19
notes: July 2026 (23 working days), employed since 1 March 2020 and still employed, age 40. Basic R4 000 (whole month) and a recurring R2 100 standby allowance that ends on Friday 10 July: 8 of 23 working days, 2 100 x 8 / 23 = 730.435 -> 730.43 (ruling 13). Gross 4 730.43; PAYE R0 (under the threshold, G21 p. 13). UIF 1% = 47.30 each side; SDL 47.30; net 4 730.43 - 47.30 = 4 683.13. Before W29 the ended row was not paid at all (gross 4 000, net 3 960).
